theorems.name: Submission.polyhedral_approx_exhaustion_function
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∃ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, LipschitzWith 1 φ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → IsCompact {x | t ≤ φ x} ∧ {x | t ≤ φ x} ⊆ U) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, δ ≤ φ x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
